question: Which products have been ordered more than once by the same customer, and what are the product ID, product name, customer ID, and customer's first and last name for each?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY p.product_id, c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;
plain_question: Which products have been ordered more than once by the same customer?

question: What is the city name and average order value per customer city?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.city, AVG(order_totals.total_value) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_value FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) order_totals ON o.order_id = order_totals.order_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
plain_question: What is the average order value per customer city?

question: How many distinct customers ordered from each product category, listed by category name and count of distinct customers?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC;
plain_question: How many distinct customers ordered from each product category?

question: What is the total inventory value, calculated as price times quantity, for each warehouse, listed by warehouse name and inventory value?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(p.price * i.quantity) AS inventory_value FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY inventory_value DESC;
plain_question: What is the total inventory value (price x quantity) per warehouse?

question: Which employees handled orders for customers from Berlin, and how many such orders did each one handle, listed by employee ID, first name, last name, and order count?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Berlin' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY order_count DESC;
plain_question: Which employees handled orders for customers from Berlin?

question: What are the highest and lowest stock quantities in each warehouse, listed by warehouse name, maximum quantity, and minimum quantity?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, MAX(i.quantity) AS max_quantity, MIN(i.quantity) AS min_quantity FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY w.warehouse_name;
plain_question: What is the most and least stocked product in each warehouse?

question: How many orders of each status were placed in each month of 2025, listed by year, month, status, and order count?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year, MONTH(o.order_date) AS order_month, o.status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date), o.status ORDER BY order_year, order_month, o.status;
plain_question: How many orders of each status were placed per month in 2025?

question: Which product categories have the highest average unit price across all orders, listed by category name, average unit price, and order count, ranked from highest to lowest?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC;
plain_question: Which categories have the highest average unit price across all orders?

question: Which customers have never placed a cancelled order, listed by customer ID, first name, and last name?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled');
plain_question: Which customers have never placed a cancelled order?

question: What is the total quantity ordered for every product, including products never ordered, listed by product ID, product name, and total quantity ordered?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_ordered DESC;
plain_question: What is the total quantity ordered for each product, including products never ordered?

question: Considering only products priced above the average product price, which customer spent the most on them, and what is their customer ID, first name, last name, and total spend?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;
plain_question: Which customer spent the most on products above the average price?

question: How do departments rank by the total order value handled by their employees, listed by department name, total value, and rank?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;
plain_question: Rank departments by total order value handled by their employees.

question: Which products have never been ordered but currently have stock, listed by product ID, product name, and total stock quantity?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING total_stock > 0;
plain_question: Which products have never been ordered but are in stock?

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from each product category, listed by category name, total revenue, and revenue percentage?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items), 2) AS revenue_percentage FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY category_revenue DESC;
plain_question: What percentage of total revenue comes from each product category?

question: Who handled the three highest-value orders overall, listed by employee ID, first name, last name, order ID, and order value?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_value FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, o.order_id ORDER BY order_value DESC LIMIT 3;
plain_question: Which employees handled the top 3 highest-value orders?

question: Who is each employee's manager, and what is the total order value each employee personally handled, listed by employee ID, first name, last name, manager's first and last name, and handled value?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COALESCE(m.first_name, 'No Manager') AS manager_first, COALESCE(m.last_name, '') AS manager_last, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS handled_value FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, m.employee_id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY handled_value DESC;
plain_question: For each employee, show their manager and the total value they handled.

question: Which product categories have more than 50 percent of their total stock located in Berlin, listed by category name, Berlin quantity, total quantity, and Berlin percentage?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin Distribution Center' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS berlin_qty, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_qty, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin Distribution Center' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(i.quantity), 2) AS berlin_percentage FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name HAVING berlin_percentage > 50 ORDER BY berlin_percentage DESC;
plain_question: Which product categories have more than 50 percent of their stock in Berlin?

question: How do customers rank by total spend from highest to lowest, listed by customer ID, first name, last name, total spend, rank, and percentage of the overall total?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS customer_rank, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
plain_question: Show customers with cumulative order totals, ranked highest to lowest.

question: Which orders included items from more than three different product categories, listed by order ID, customer ID, number of distinct categories, and category names?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_id) AS category_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS categories FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_id) > 3 ORDER BY category_count DESC;
plain_question: Which orders had items from more than 3 different categories?

question: What is the month-over-month growth in total order value, listed by month, that month's total order value, and the previous month's total order value?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT month_summary.month, month_summary.monthly_revenue, LAG(month_summary.monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_summary.month) AS prev_month_revenue FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-01')) month_summary ORDER BY month_summary.month;
plain_question: What is the month-over-month growth in total order value?
